phase_name: Remove routing and routing_hard from every manifest

objectives.description: Re-run block inventory sweep to confirm 17+2 target set
Delete routing_hard key from cslib and lean
Re-validate every edited manifest parses as JSON, no sibling key reformatted

approaches_tried.approach: Used `jq 'del(.routing, .routing_hard)' file > tmp && mv` for all 17 manifests uniformly
approaches_tried.reason: jq's pretty-printer unconditionally expands every array onto multiple lines; rust/manifest.json had a hand-compacted single-line keywords array (keyword_overrides.rust.keywords) that jq reformatted into a multi-line array, violating the 'routing/routing_hard hunks only' diff requirement. Fixed by reverting rust/manifest.json to its original content (via git show HEAD) and rewriting it with the Write tool, preserving the original single-line array exactly and removing only the routing block by hand. All other 16 manifests had no such inline-compacted arrays and jq's rewrite produced clean diffs.
